title: Cobblemon Explorers SMP Server
description:
- Cobblemon, Mega Showdown , Raids , + Many Other additions with a Vanilla + Minecraft feel ! Economy based with Event Drops.All with NO P2W benefits ,any support is cosmetic or benefits all players via boost.

Great Community, Great Vibes
body:
Based on our previous server Cobblemon Explorers , We've built this server for Cobblemon 1.7 (MC version 1.21.1 Fabric) , so If you're looking for a server built around a player-driven economy, relaxing and rewarding farming, Cobblemon adventures, and a friendly, tight-knit community, all with no pay to win? This could be the place for you!

✨ Player-based Economy — Trade, buy, sell, and build your wealth your way while saving up to try to increase your claim size.

🌾 Farming Focused — Grow your choice of money makers and master things like seasons and crop influence to earn more money for more claim blocks to expand your land.

⛏️ Slightly increase difficulty — Hard mode for one, then some recipes have been modified to make the game slighty 'harder', aswell as villager trades have been modified. No keep INV but there are graves.

🎊  Cobblemon — Many Cobblemon Additions you know and love, and now ride your Cobblemon in style as the new method of transportation ! NO waystones in this pack to keep the world feeling big and inspire community driven projects like roads and tunnels for us to use our pokemon on ! Raids, Different sized Pokemon, Battle Tower, Safari zone, Dex rewards, All Gimmicks (mega,dynamax,tera etc) and a small region built to house a small story + more. Enjoy GLOBAL shiny boost when players support the server- preventing a p2w advantage and benefiting everyone when a player supports the server

🤝 Cozy Community Vibes — Great community, Good vibes. PVP is allowed on this server- but you can easily toggle it with /pvp . Creating a 'fight when you want' type of environment. 

📜 Small Story with Quests + Daily Quests — Enjoy a small custom region that has npcs and a league you can go through with a small storyline to it to help connect minecraft and cobblemon that little bit more. Aswell as Daily tasks + quests to earn money.

🔧 Performance Light for clients — Very limited required client side mods so that lower end computers are less likeley to have issues .

+ MORE


Grab your gear, bring your friends, and get ready to explore ! See you there Explorers !
